name: Ironboot's warning

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Back in Tanaris, Ironboot reads the tablets as evidence that the egg can serve a larger purpose: Hakkar may be reborn in the depths of Zul'Gurub. That is Ironboot's interpretation of the text, not a fact the seeker has yet witnessed. The later manual's account of Zul'Gurub shows why his warning matters, while keeping this warning distinct from the temple avatar's defeat.
